spec.name: nats
spec.code:
/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

spec.name: globSpec
spec.code:
/-- `pattern` matches `name`: `*` any run of bytes, `?` exactly one. -/
def globSpec : List Nat → List Nat → Bool
  | [], n => n = []
  | 42 :: p, n => globSpec p n || match n with
    | [] => false
    | _ :: n' => globSpec (42 :: p) n'
  | 63 :: p, n => match n with
    | [] => false
    | _ :: n' => globSpec p n'
  | c :: p, n => match n with
    | [] => false
    | x :: n' => c = x && globSpec p n'
termination_by p n => p.length + n.length

/-- [rustfs_kernel::wildmatch::inner_match]:
    Source: 'src/wildmatch.rs', lines 27:0-35:1 -/
def wildmatch.inner_match
  (pattern : Slice Std.U8) («name» : Slice Std.U8) (simple : Bool) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let i := Slice.len pattern
  if i = 0#usize
  then let i1 := Slice.len «name»
       ok (i1 = 0#usize)
  else
    let i1 := Slice.len pattern
    if i1 = 1#usize
    then
      let i2 ← Slice.index_usize pattern 0#usize
      if i2 = 42#u8
      then ok true
      else wildmatch.deep_match pattern 0#usize «name» 0#usize simple
    else wildmatch.deep_match pattern 0#usize «name» 0#usize simple

lean.code:
/-- [rustfs_kernel::wildmatch::deep_match]:
    Source: 'src/wildmatch.rs', lines 5:0-25:1 -/
def wildmatch.deep_match
  (p : Slice Std.U8) (pi : Std.Usize) (n : Slice Std.U8) (ni : Std.Usize)
  (simple : Bool) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let i := Slice.len p
  if pi >= i
  then let i1 := Slice.len n
       ok (ni >= i1)
  else
    let c ← Slice.index_usize p pi
    if c = 63#u8
    then
      let i1 := Slice.len n
      if ni >= i1
      then ok simple
      else
        let i2 ← pi + 1#usize
        let i3 ← ni + 1#usize
        wildmatch.deep_match p i2 n i3 simple
    else
      if c = 42#u8
      then
        let i1 := Slice.len p
        let i2 ← i1 - pi
        if i2 = 1#usize
        then ok true
        else
          let i3 ← pi + 1#usize
          let b ← wildmatch.deep_match p i3 n ni simple
          if b
          then ok true
          else
            let i4 := Slice.len n
            if ni < i4
            then let i5 ← ni + 1#usize
                 wildmatch.deep_match p pi n i5 simple
            else ok false
      else
        let i1 := Slice.len n
        if ni >= i1
        then ok false
        else
          let i2 ← Slice.index_usize n ni
          if i2 != c
          then ok false
          else
            let i3 ← pi + 1#usize
            let i4 ← ni + 1#usize
            wildmatch.deep_match p i3 n i4 simple

import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec H5iAppLib

namespace rustfs_kernel.Solution

def globAt (pattern : List U8) (pi : Nat) (input : List U8) (ni : Nat) : Bool :=
  globSpec (nats (pattern.drop pi)) (nats (input.drop ni))

theorem nats_drop_cons (pattern : List U8) (pi : Nat) (hp : pi < pattern.length) :
    nats (pattern.drop pi) = pattern[pi].val :: nats (pattern.drop (pi + 1)) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hp]
  rfl

theorem glob_single_star (input : List Nat) : globSpec [42] input = true := by
  induction input with
  | nil => simp [globSpec]
  | cons head tail ih => simp [globSpec, ih]

theorem globAt_end (pattern input : List U8) (pi ni : Nat) (hp : pattern.length ≤ pi) :
    globAt pattern pi input ni = decide (input.length ≤ ni) := by
  simp [globAt, List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hp, nats, globSpec]

theorem globAt_step (pattern input : List U8) (pi ni : Nat) (hp : pi < pattern.length) :
    globAt pattern pi input ni =
      if pattern[pi].val = 63 then
        if ni < input.length then globAt pattern (pi + 1) input (ni + 1) else false
      else if pattern[pi].val = 42 then
        globAt pattern (pi + 1) input ni ||
          (if ni < input.length then globAt pattern pi input (ni + 1) else false)
      else
        if hn : ni < input.length then
          decide (pattern[pi].val = input[ni].val) && globAt pattern (pi + 1) input (ni + 1)
        else false := by
  unfold globAt
  rw [nats_drop_cons pattern pi hp]
  by_cases hq : pattern[pi].val = 63
  · by_cases hn : ni < input.length
    · rw [nats_drop_cons input ni hn]
      simp [hq, hn, globSpec]
    · have he : input.drop ni = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
      simp [hq, hn, he, nats, globSpec]
  · by_cases hs : pattern[pi].val = 42
    · by_cases hn : ni < input.length
      · rw [nats_drop_cons input ni hn]
        simp [hs, hn, globSpec]
      · have he : input.drop ni = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
        simp [hs, hn, he, nats, globSpec]
    · by_cases hn : ni < input.length
      · rw [nats_drop_cons input ni hn]
        simp [hq, hs, hn, globSpec]
      · have he : input.drop ni = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
        simp [hq, hs, hn, he, nats, globSpec]

theorem globAt_last_star (pattern input : List U8) (pi ni : Nat)
    (hp : pi < pattern.length) (hs : pattern[pi].val = 42) (hl : pattern.length - pi = 1) :
    globAt pattern pi input ni = true := by
  have he : pattern.drop (pi + 1) = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
  unfold globAt
  rw [nats_drop_cons pattern pi hp, hs, he]
  exact glob_single_star _

theorem deep_match_spec (pattern input : Slice U8) (pi ni : Usize)
    (hp : pi.val ≤ pattern.val.length) (hn : ni.val ≤ input.val.length) :
    wildmatch.deep_match pattern pi input ni false ⦃ matched => matched = globAt pattern.val pi.val input.val ni.val ⦄ := by
  generalize hm : pattern.val.length - pi.val + (input.val.length - ni.val) = measure
  induction measure using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing pi ni with
  | h measure ih =>
    unfold wildmatch.deep_match
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i he
      simp only [WP.spec_ok]
      rw [globAt_end pattern.val input.val pi.val ni.val (by scalar_tac)]
      simp only [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, Slice.len_val]
    · rename_i he
      have hpi : pi.val < pattern.val.length := by scalar_tac
      step as ⟨character, hc⟩
      subst character
      rw [globAt_step pattern.val input.val pi.val ni.val hpi]
      split
      · rename_i hq
        have hqv : pattern.val[pi.val].val = 63 := by scalar_tac
        simp only [hqv, reduceIte]
        split
        · rename_i hend
          have hnv : ¬ni.val < input.val.length := by scalar_tac
          simp [hnv]
        · rename_i hne
          have hni : ni.val < input.val.length := by scalar_tac
          simp only [hni, reduceIte]
          step as ⟨pj, hpj⟩
          step as ⟨nj, hnj⟩
          have hrec := ih _ (by omega) pj nj (by omega) (by omega) rfl
          simpa only [hpj, hnj] using hrec
      · rename_i hq
        have hqv : pattern.val[pi.val].val ≠ 63 := by
          intro hv
          apply hq
          scalar_tac
        simp only [hqv, reduceIte]
        split
        · rename_i hs
          have hsv : pattern.val[pi.val].val = 42 := by scalar_tac
          simp only [hsv, reduceIte]
          step as ⟨remaining, hremaining, hbound⟩
          split
          · rename_i hlast
            have hl : pattern.val.length - pi.val = 1 := by scalar_tac
            have hmodel := globAt_last_star pattern.val input.val pi.val ni.val hpi hsv hl
            rw [globAt_step pattern.val input.val pi.val ni.val hpi] at hmodel
            simpa [hqv, hsv] using hmodel.symm
          · rename_i hlast
            step as ⟨pj, hpj⟩
            have hrec := ih _ (by omega) pj ni (by omega) hn rfl
            step with hrec as ⟨matched, hmatched⟩
            have hmatch : matched = globAt pattern.val (pi.val + 1) input.val ni.val := by
              simpa only [hpj] using hmatched
            split
            · rename_i htrue
              simp [← hmatch, htrue]
            · rename_i hfalse
              have hmf : matched = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hfalse
              have hmodel_false : globAt pattern.val (pi.val + 1) input.val ni.val = false :=
                hmatch.symm.trans hmf
              simp only [hmodel_false, Bool.false_or]
              split
              · rename_i hmore
                have hni : ni.val < input.val.length := by scalar_tac
                simp only [hni, reduceIte]
                step as ⟨nj, hnj⟩
                have hrec := ih _ (by omega) pi nj hp (by omega) rfl
                simpa only [hnj] using hrec
              · rename_i hmore
                have hni : ¬ni.val < input.val.length := by scalar_tac
                simp [hni]
        · rename_i hs
          have hsv : pattern.val[pi.val].val ≠ 42 := by
            intro hv
            apply hs
            scalar_tac
          simp only [hsv, reduceIte]
          split
          · rename_i hend
            have hni : ¬ni.val < input.val.length := by scalar_tac
            simp [hni]
          · rename_i hne
            have hni : ni.val < input.val.length := by scalar_tac
            simp only [hni, reduceDIte]
            step as ⟨actual, hactual⟩
            subst actual
            split
            · rename_i hdiff
              have hv : pattern.val[pi.val].val ≠ input.val[ni.val].val := by
                intro hv
                have heq : input.val[ni.val] = pattern.val[pi.val] := by scalar_tac
                simp [heq] at hdiff
              simp [hv]
            · rename_i hsame
              have hv : pattern.val[pi.val].val = input.val[ni.val].val := by
                have heq : input.val[ni.val] = pattern.val[pi.val] := by
                  simpa only [bne_iff_ne, not_not] using hsame
                scalar_tac
              simp only [hv, decide_true, Bool.true_and]
              step as ⟨pj, hpj⟩
              step as ⟨nj, hnj⟩
              have hrec := ih _ (by omega) pj nj (by omega) (by omega) rfl
              simpa only [hpj, hnj] using hrec

theorem wildcard_is_glob (p n : Slice U8) :
    wildmatch.is_match p n = ok (globSpec (nats p.val) (nats n.val)) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  unfold wildmatch.is_match wildmatch.inner_match
  dsimp only
  split
  · rename_i hempty
    have hpv : p.val = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by scalar_tac)
    simp [hpv, nats, globSpec, UScalar.eq_equiv]
  · rename_i hnonempty
    split
    · rename_i hsingle
      step as ⟨first, hfirst⟩
      split
      · rename_i hstar
        have hp : 0 < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
        have hs : p.val[0].val = 42 := by scalar_tac
        have hl : p.val.length - 0 = 1 := by scalar_tac
        have hmodel := globAt_last_star p.val n.val 0 0 hp hs hl
        simpa only [globAt, List.drop_zero, WP.spec_ok] using hmodel.symm
      · simpa [globAt] using
          deep_match_spec p n 0#usize 0#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac)
    · simpa [globAt] using
        deep_match_spec p n 0#usize 0#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac)

end rustfs_kernel.Solution

import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec H5iAppLib

namespace rustfs_kernel.Solution

theorem glob_nil (n : List Nat) : globSpec [] n = decide (n = []) := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; try rfl

theorem glob_star (p n : List Nat) : globSpec (42 :: p) n =
    (globSpec p n || match n with
      | [] => false
      | _ :: n' => globSpec (42 :: p) n') := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; try rfl

theorem glob_q (p n : List Nat) : globSpec (63 :: p) n =
    (match n with
      | [] => false
      | _ :: n' => globSpec p n') := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; try rfl

theorem glob_lit (c : Nat) (p n : List Nat) (h1 : c ≠ 42) (h2 : c ≠ 63) :
    globSpec (c :: p) n =
    (match n with
      | [] => false
      | x :: n' => (decide (c = x) && globSpec p n')) := by
  rw [globSpec.eq_def]; try rfl
  split <;> first | rfl | (simp_all; done) | (rename_i h; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; rfl)

theorem glob_star_end (n : List Nat) : globSpec [42] n = true := by
  induction n with
  | nil => rw [glob_star, glob_nil]; simp
  | cons x n ih => rw [glob_star]; simp [ih]

theorem nats_drop (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) :
    nats (l.drop i) = l[i].val :: nats (l.drop (i+1)) := by
  unfold nats; rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h]; rfl

theorem nats_drop_ge (l : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : l.length ≤ i) :
    nats (l.drop i) = [] := by
  simp [nats, List.drop_eq_nil_of_le h]

theorem deep_match_spec (p n : Slice U8) : ∀ k (pi ni : Usize),
    p.length - pi.val + (n.length - ni.val) = k →
    wildmatch.deep_match p pi n ni false
      = ok (globSpec (nats (p.val.drop pi.val)) (nats (n.val.drop ni.val))) := by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
  intro pi ni hk
  simp only [Slice.length] at hk ih
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  rw [wildmatch.deep_match]
  h5i_steps
  · -- end of pattern
    have h1 : p.val.length ≤ pi.val := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop_ge _ _ h1, glob_nil]
    by_cases h2 : n.val.length ≤ ni.val
    · rw [nats_drop_ge _ _ h2]; simp; scalar_tac
    · rw [nats_drop _ _ (by omega)]; simp; scalar_tac
  · -- `?` at end of name
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hn : n.val.length ≤ ni.val := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post
    have hc : (p.val[pi.val]).val = 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, nats_drop_ge _ _ hn, hc, glob_q]
  · -- `?` step
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hn : ni.val < n.val.length := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post
    have hc : (p.val[pi.val]).val = 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [ih _ (by scalar_tac) i2 i3 rfl]
    simp only [WP.spec_ok]
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, nats_drop _ _ hn, hc, glob_q, i2_post, i3_post]
  · -- trailing `*`
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have he : p.val.length ≤ pi.val + 1 := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post
    have hc : (p.val[pi.val]).val = 42 := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, nats_drop_ge _ _ he, hc, glob_star_end]
  · -- `*`, name not exhausted
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hn : ni.val < n.val.length := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post
    have hc : (p.val[pi.val]).val = 42 := by scalar_tac
    rw [ih _ (by scalar_tac) i3 ni rfl]
    simp only [bind_ok]
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, hc, i3_post, nats_drop _ _ hn, glob_star]
    by_cases hb : globSpec (nats (List.drop (pi.val + 1) p.val)) (↑(n.val[ni.val]) :: nats (List.drop (ni.val + 1) n.val)) = true
    · simp [hb]
    · simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Bool.false_or]
      step as ⟨i5, i5_post⟩
      rw [ih _ (by scalar_tac) pi i5 rfl]
      simp only [WP.spec_ok]
      rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, hc, i5_post]
  · -- `*`, name exhausted
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hn : n.val.length ≤ ni.val := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post
    have hc : (p.val[pi.val]).val = 42 := by scalar_tac
    rw [ih _ (by scalar_tac) i3 ni rfl]
    simp only [bind_ok]
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, hc, i3_post, nats_drop_ge _ _ hn, glob_star]
    split <;> simp_all
  · -- literal, name exhausted
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hn : n.val.length ≤ ni.val := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post
    have h1 : (p.val[pi.val]).val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have h2 : (p.val[pi.val]).val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, nats_drop_ge _ _ hn, glob_lit _ _ _ h1 h2]
  · -- literal mismatch
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hn : ni.val < n.val.length := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post i2_post
    have h1 : (p.val[pi.val]).val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have h2 : (p.val[pi.val]).val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rename_i hne
    have h3 : (p.val[pi.val]).val ≠ (n.val[ni.val]).val := by
      intro h; simp [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, u8_eq_iff, h] at hne
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, nats_drop _ _ hn, glob_lit _ _ _ h1 h2]
    simp [h3]
  · -- literal step
    have hp : pi.val < p.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hn : ni.val < n.val.length := by scalar_tac
    subst c_post i2_post
    have h1 : (p.val[pi.val]).val ≠ 42 := by scalar_tac
    have h2 : (p.val[pi.val]).val ≠ 63 := by scalar_tac
    rename_i heq
    have h3 : (p.val[pi.val]).val = (n.val[ni.val]).val := by
      simp [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, u8_eq_iff] at heq; omega
    rw [ih _ (by scalar_tac) i3 i4 rfl]
    simp only [WP.spec_ok]
    rw [nats_drop _ _ hp, nats_drop _ _ hn, glob_lit _ _ _ h1 h2, i3_post, i4_post]
    simp [h3]

theorem wildcard_is_glob (p n : Slice U8) :
    wildmatch.is_match p n = ok (globSpec (nats p.val) (nats n.val)) := by
  have hd : wildmatch.deep_match p 0#usize n 0#usize false
      = ok (globSpec (nats p.val) (nats n.val)) := by
    rw [deep_match_spec p n _ 0#usize 0#usize rfl]; rfl
  rw [wildmatch.is_match, wildmatch.inner_match]
  by_cases h0 : p.len = 0#usize
  · have : p.val = [] := by
      have : p.val.length = 0 := by scalar_tac
      exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero this
    simp only [h0, if_true, this, nats, List.map_nil, glob_nil]
    congr 2
    simp only [List.map_eq_nil_iff, eq_iff_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h; apply List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero; scalar_tac
    · intro h; scalar_tac
  · simp only [h0, if_false]
    by_cases h1 : p.len = 1#usize
    · have hl : p.val.length = 1 := by scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hl
      have hs := Slice.index_usize_spec p 0#usize (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ok_of hs
      have hyx : y = x := by have := post_of_ok hs hy; simp_all
      subst hyx
      simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte, hy, bind_ok]
      by_cases hc : y = 42#u8
      · simp [hc, hx, nats, glob_star_end]
      · simp only [hc, if_false, hd]
    · simp only [h1, if_false, hd]

end rustfs_kernel.Solution
